text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: planning a deploy tomorrow 09:00 PDT for inference-routing fixes. Need final sign-offs and smoke owners. Quick checklist below, pls ack or call out blockers.

Maya Patel: Checklist: 1) CI green ✅ 2) Canary lane owners assigned 3) Smoke runbook updated 4) Rollback tested 5) Observability dashboards pinned 6) Quota bump requested for burst windows

Sam Ortiz: CI is green on main, e2e flaky test fixed in PR #4821. I can own the canary lane. :thumbsup:

Liam Nguyen: I updated the smoke runbook with commands and expected traces. I can run smoke if Sam owns canary.

Ana Rodriguez: Quota bump requested with infra, ticket INF-339. Should be approved by 17:00 PT today. I validated the model variant mapping for fallback.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Can everyone confirm rollback readiness? Steps are in runbook under /runbooks/deploys/inference-route.md. Quick confirm: has anyone run `rollback --dry-run` locally?

Liam Nguyen: Ran `rollback --dry-run` against staging, no issues. Logs show clean KV-cache invalidation.

Sam Ortiz: I haven't done the local dry run yet, will run by EOD and report.

Jen (oncall): Deploy window reserved in pager schedule, oncall coverage OK. I'll monitor latency and error budget.

DeployBot: Reminder: deploy window reserved for 2026-06-12 16:00Z - owners: @SamOrtiz, @LiamNguyen. Auto-notify 30m before start.

Maya Patel: Two small asks: (a) canary traffic split = 5% for 15m then 25% for 10m if metrics stable; (b) smoke checklist snippets below — please copy into the runbook if anything missing.

Maya Patel: Smoke checklist snippet:
```
# smoke steps
1. curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke-test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY'
2. tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep "batch" || true
3. check datadog: query avg(latency) by model for last 5m
4. verify KV cache hit rate > 60% for canary nodes
```

Sam Ortiz: Adding a quick load step to catch batching regressions: `wrk -c 50 -t 4 -d 60s https://canary.redwood.ai/health`

Ana Rodriguez: Small note — if quota hasn't cleared, we have fallback region plan (eu-west-1) in runbook. Will call it out in the runbook.

Maya Patel: Approvals: please react or reply with exact text to be counted as sign-off. I'll collect and lock the window at 17:45 PT.

Liam Nguyen: sign-off: canary owner, smoke runner.

Sam Ortiz: sign-off: canary owner (will run post-deploy load).

Jen (oncall): sign-off: oncall monitoring and rollback lead.

Ana Rodriguez: sign-off: infra quota/region fallback owner.

Maya Patel: Great — final note: if any metric crosses alert threshold during the 25% phase, automatic rollback to previous model variant. Ops playbook step included. See you tomorrow; will post a final pre-deploy ack 30m prior. :rocket:
